RegisterWriteConfigurations.Description: Keep the EC's dGPU GC6 flag (GC6F) in sync with GPU activity
LuaCode: -- GC6F is the EC field at register 0x08, bit 0. The EC runs a fan
-- whenever the dGPU is powered, unless the firmware tells it the GPU
-- entered its GC6 low-power state. The Windows NVIDIA driver does this
-- via the firmware's GC6I/GC6O; the Linux driver does not, because the
-- GPU ACPI node has no _PR3, so the EC's dGPU fan floor stays on even
-- Mirror GC6 entry/exit from the GPU's temperature: tell the EC the GPU
-- is in GC6 when it is cool (so the fan may stop), and clear it when it
-- is hot so the EC runs its own dGPU thermal zone.
